root_causes_identified.name: Missing KaTeX include
root_causes_identified.description: Enrichment subagents added $..$ / $$..$$ math content without verifying the host file's <head> loaded KaTeX. Math rendered as raw '$' text on Kindle.
root_causes_identified.status: fixed in prior cycle (63 files); verified 0 remaining

root_causes_identified.name: Overflow-prone math
root_causes_identified.description: Long display equations (>120 chars on a single line, no \\\\ break) clip on Kindle's narrow viewport. Inline math >80 chars same risk.
root_causes_identified.status: covered by global CSS .katex-display { overflow-x: auto } added prior cycle; 4 worst offenders split into \begin{aligned} blocks then; remaining 113 ride the CSS safety net

root_causes_identified.name: Overflow-prone non-math
root_causes_identified.description: Subagents emitted SVGs with lowercase 'viewbox' (silently dropped by EPUB XHTML parser, causing SVG to render at intrinsic size and clip), wide tables, long pre/code lines.
root_causes_identified.status: FIXED THIS CYCLE: 209 lowercase viewbox->viewBox attrs in 138 files; CSS safety nets added (svg{max-width:100%}, img{max-width:100%}, .content table {overflow-x:auto})

root_causes_identified.name: Math inside special containers
root_causes_identified.description: Math inside callout / diagram-caption / code-caption / figcaption potentially blocked by KaTeX ignoredClasses config.
root_causes_identified.status: VERIFIED NOT A BUG: 0 KaTeX configs use ignoredClasses anywhere in the book. Auto-render walks descendants normally.

root_causes_identified.name: HTML inconsistencies (NEW: unescaped < and > in attribute values)
root_causes_identified.description: Subagents wrote alt='Figure X.Y: ...' (raw markup inside attribute value) and SVGs with bare > inside aria-label='temperature T>1'. Browsers tolerate, XHTML/EPUB silently truncates the attribute, causing visible breakage in Kindle.
root_causes_identified.status: FIXED THIS CYCLE: 1 SVG (T>1 -> T>1) + 17 alt-attribute HTML strippings in 14 files. Audit residual: 1 false-positive (audit regex matched SVG <text> element content).

css_safety_net_appended_to_book_css: svg { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }  (global SVG responsive)
img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }  (global img responsive)
.content table { overflow-x: auto; max-width: 100%; }  (table reflow at all viewports, not just <=768)
guardrail_added: KDP/build/_audit_root_causes.py - mirror of slide-summaries audit; run before each KDP build to catch regressions
remaining_known_issues_intentionally_unf: RC2 long_display_math (113): CSS overflow-x:auto handles the clip; splitting all 113 by hand would risk arithmetic errors in PhD-authored content. Surgical splits already applied to the 4 worst offenders in prior cycle.
RC2 long_inline_math (312): regex counts \frac{a}{b} as long even though it renders short; most are false positives. KaTeX inline auto-shrink handles real overflow.
RC3 long_code_lines (336): CSS pre { overflow-x: auto } handles. Reflowing code at runtime would mangle indentation.
RC3 wide_tables (55): existing .content table overflow-x:auto + new global rule handle this at every viewport.
RC4 math_in_containers (56): not a bug - KaTeX renders normally inside callouts/captions (verified: no ignoredClasses config).
RC5 code_caption_above_code (9): inspected - all 9 are false positives (caption between pre N and pre N+1 misclassified as 'above pre N+1'). Algorithm tightened but still has edge cases.
RC5 figures_without_figcaption (8): all in front-matter (author photos, copyright page) where captions are intentionally omitted.
RC5 pre_without_code_block_wrapper (60): stylistic preference, not a bug - bare <pre> still has overflow-x:auto via direct <pre> rule.
html_entity_bugs (1): false positive - audit regex matched SVG <text> element label text ('target = ...') as if it were an HTML attribute.
